result.title: TSFFormer: A Frequency-Domain Spike Transformer for Green Human Activity Recognition
result.summary: Wearable Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs) enable pervasive Human Activity Recognition (HAR), but traditional Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) suffer from an "arithmetic-latency deadlock" due to dense floating-point MAC operations. While Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer ultra-low power, existing ones face spatial blind spots, rigid neurons, and gradient degradation. To address these, we propose TSFFormer, a purely spiking Fourier Transformer for Green HAR. It introduces two key innovations: (1) a MultiHeadFourier attention that performs frequency-domain global mixing, reducing complexity from \(O(V^2)\) to \(O(V\log V)\), eliminating spatial blind spots, and saving \(\sim\)50% GPU memory; and (2) a dual-compartment Temporal Spiking LIF (TSLIFNode) that utilizes dynamic thresholds to adapt to non-stationary rhythms and mitigate gradient degradation. Extensive experiments on 8 public IMU benchmarks demonstrate that TSFFormer surpasses state-of-the-art SNNs and even the classic DeepConvLSTM, achieving a \(\sim\)3\(\times\) faster training speed with an energy footprint of 0.1 pJ. Ablation studies confirm the synergistic effect of our modules, providing a highly accurate, ultra-low-power event-driven paradigm for wearable sensing.

AI.brief_summary: 提出纯脉冲神经网络 TSFFormer，用频域多头注意力做全局混合，并以双隔室动态阈值脉冲神经元适配非平稳活动节律，用于可穿戴 IMU 人体活动识别。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作面向 IMU 时序分类的能效与延迟优化，既不涉及视觉或多模态推理中的证据筛选、状态生成与停止决策，其频域注意力与动态阈值神经元也更偏硬件能效实现，未提供可核查的 LVR 方法线索。
